note: CIBC Caribbean's St Kitts and Nevis schedule of charges for cards (effective December 2019, last updated September 2026), read in full: the personal cards in Eastern Caribbean dollars are written, each with its annual fee for the primary card (none where the schedule gives 0.00; the British Airways Visa Platinum's waived for its first year), its yearly purchase rate, its cash advance rate and 3.50% cash advance fee, its 1.01% foreign transaction fee on the Eastern Caribbean dollar cards, its late payment, over limit and returned cheque fees, and its late payment rate as the penalty rate. The UWI cards are for the University of the West Indies' students, faculty and alumni, a condition the game doesn't check; the UWI rewards card's waiver for faculty isn't written. The commercial and business cards aren't written; nor are the replacement card, statement, rush card, emergency payment and auto-payment charges, which a holder meets only by asking or by an auto-payment. The schedule states no minimum payment or grace period for the personal cards. The schedule says all its fees include VAT, so no tax is added. Republic Bank's St Kitts Republic Mastercard page, its rates and fees table (in effect as of September 1, 2021), read in full: the Republic Bank Mastercard, Mastercard Gold and AAdvantage Mastercard, all fees in Eastern Caribbean dollars, each with its annual membership fee for the primary card, 22% a year on purchases and balance transfers (the bank says the rate is set on approval and could be 22%, the only figure it gives), a minimum payment of 2.77% of the principal balance plus the period's interest (the 'any other fees' it also adds aren't modelled), a cash advance fee of 3.2% with a floor, the late payment, returned cheque and over limit charges, and an interest-free period of at least 50 days on purchases when the statement is paid in full (written as 50). The replacement card and statement charges aren't written. The page states no foreign transaction fee or penalty rate. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: the RBC Caribbean credit card pages, rendered, list no personal card for the Eastern Caribbean, only business cards; the St Kitts-Nevis-Anguilla National Bank's site sits behind a Cloudflare check and the Bank of Nevis's didn't answer. No minimum payment is published for CIBC Caribbean's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; CIBC Caribbean's schedule of charges for the country gives a minimum only for its JetBlue cards (written where it has them) and 10% for business cards; its FirstCaribbean credit card cardholder agreement (7040CC-FC-24-02, read in full) says only 'the minimum payment required as stipulated in the monthly statement'; a search in English for CIBC Caribbean's minimum payment found only CIBC Canada's documents and a calculator site; archive.org's availability API, asked for each of the 2 documents this file cites, names a snapshot for 1 of them, which can't be read, web.archive.org being refused from here.
